profile.bio: I am a postdoctoral researcher with Florida International University, in Michael Heithaus' Marine Community and Behavioural Ecology Lab, and Yannis Papastamatiou's Predator Ecology Lab. I am also a Science Board Member for Saving The Blue, an NGO based in Miami and Andros, Bahamas. I developed gbm.auto, R software to automate the deployment of Boosted Regression Tree machine-learning species distribution models during my PhD, and led the development of movegroup with Dr Maurits van Zinnicq Bergmann.
